The family's own committed treatment record (data/rcap-all50/terminalization-treatments/vt.json, trackId vt_seal_pardon) is exact_supported_deferral: the statute does not resolve whether a pardoned misdemeanour runs on the three-year clock at 13 V.S.A. § 7602(c) or the seven-year clock at § 7602(d), and that timing question decides when the participant may file at all. FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: The packet never addresses what this costs. participant-instructions.md contains no fee, cost, charge or payment statement anywhere — I searched the whole file including its tables — and it does not say there is no fee, does not name an amount, and does not tell the participant whom to ask. I also decoded the shifted page-1 font myself and found no fee statement on the form face, so the likely truth is that no fee applies; but the packet nowhere says so, and a participant cannot tell the difference between 'no fee' and 'not mentioned'. FILING_DESTINATION.finding: The held source states the destination on its own printed face and the packet tells the participant to go find it out. Printed instruction 1 of the delivered form reads: 'Submit your application to the Court where you were convicted.' participant-instructions.md line 12 instead reads: 'Confirm current revision, filing destination, local procedures, fees, attachments, service, and proposed-order requirements before filing.' Amendment A1 is exactly on point — ask first whether the repository establishes the answer, and if it does, the packet states it. Substituting a question for an answer already printed on the paper in the packet is the defect the amendment names.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: Same defect, and this one has been carried as a legal blocker for the whole sprint. The delivered form's printed instruction 1 states, in a parenthesis on its own face: '(NOTE: There is no application fee.)' The packet does not say so anywhere; line 12 tells the participant to confirm fees before filing. WAVE_2_LEGAL_INPUT_ASSIGNMENTS.json records this family's decisive obligation as 'fee and waiver treatment' with the blocker 'The review instructions require current local fees to be confirmed' — that is, the blocker is manufactured by the packet's own catch-all sentence, not by any unanswered question, and the assignment's four evidence paths are all this family's own records. MASTER_QUEUE carries legalInputStatus OPEN_LEGAL_INPUT on that basis and the prior lane returned BLOCKED_LEGAL_INPUT on it. The fee question for this route is answered by the held source. This is a packet-content defect, not an open legal input, and the correct verdict is a repair rather than a block. I record the disagreement with MASTER_QUEUE rather than editing it; that file is not this lane's to touch.

evidence.whyThatStatusIsWrong: the held source establishes the fee on its face; the recorded blocker quotes the packet's own catch-all sentence back as the obstacle

SERVICE.finding: Silence dressed as a checklist item. The delivered form allocates service to the court: item 6 of its processing checklist reads 'Copies of application sent to prosecutor, law enforcement agencies and DCJS as applicable for further processing', and the form carries no certificate of service and no participant service block among its 33 fields. The packet states none of that. It offers instead two generic template lines — 'Complete service certificates only after service actually occurs', for certificates this form does not have, and 'Confirm ... service ... before filing'. Under DET-FEE-AND-WAIVER-001 as extended to SERVICE, gesturing without naming who answers is the not-met case, and here the repository answers it anyway.

evidence.onTheDeliveredFormsFace: checklist item 6 — the court sends copies to prosecutor, law enforcement and DCJS

SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: Present, though thinner than its siblings and carried substantially by the source. The instructions open 'These files are deterministic review fixtures made from exact held official sources. They are not approved filing packets', and state that the artifact covers only an explicitly requested irreversible-destruction branch and grants no runtime permission to select it. The delivered form's own DISCLAIMER carries the consequence that matters most for an irreversible destruction — that DCJS will no longer be able to verify the conviction was vacated, 'it will appear that the events never occurred' — and tells the reader they may wish to consult an attorney. The obligation is met; recorded for the repair queue that a participant-facing packet should carry its own stop rather than lean on the form's.
